doc: Text-driven lip sync for cutscene faces (M2-CHR-10; docs/kb/tech/cutscenes.md 'Faces'). No voice: the mouth is driven from the line's text, timed to the DialogueBox reveal (char i spans i/cps .. (i+1)/cps seconds, plus lead_s). FaceVisemes turns the text into viseme segments: graphemes (longest first; '^' = word start only, '$' = word end only; an empty list is a silent group), then letters; soft: a letter before one of `before` takes v instead; double letters merge; silent_final_e drops a word-final e after a consonant when the word has an earlier vowel; letters in neither table (h, k, g, q, r, digits, apostrophes) are transparent: they take time but no shape, so their neighbours shape them. pauses: punctuation that closes the mouth to rest, extended over the spaces after it. LipSync blends the segments (co-articulation, after Cohen and Massaro's dominance model): each segment pulls toward its viseme's shapes with dominance `a`, falling off exp(-d / tau) with the time d outside the segment, tau = `ahead` before it (anticipation: rounding for o/u reaches further) and `behind` after it; base_rest is a constant pull to rest. Near a `closures` segment (mbp, fv) the blend is pulled onto that viseme by closures[v] * exp(-d / closure_tau), so the jaw and every other shape go to 0 and the lips really meet. The result is sampled at sample_hz, scaled by the line's emotion intensity, then slew-limited per shape (max_rate_per_s, weight per second; look-ahead: every low point is reached on time because the limiter starts the descent early, and an opening too short to reach full height simply opens less; peak_shapes are limited the other way round, so a closure rises early and is never cut short). It ends at rest tail_s after the last character. A skipped reveal releases at release_per_s. idle: small asymmetric drifts (amp * (0.5 + 0.5 sin(2 pi hz t + phase)), phase seeded per line) faded in and out over idle_fade_s while a line plays, so the mouth is never dead still between words. shapes: viseme -> {blend shape: weight} at intensity 1; the vis_* shapes already carry their own jaw (asha_face_shapes.py VISEMES), so no extra jaw_open is added. intensity: emotion tag -> scale (default for an untagged line or an unlisted tag).
